changes.comment: #209 core-neutrality cleanup for the built-in Claude Code Agent Runtime: the package owns its own engine-specific concerns (the neutral diagnostic, stderr log composition, resident session) and ships a default provider-factory export so `builtin:claude-code` loads through the host's single dynamic provider loader like an npm: provider.
